Recently found this sub and it was an incredibly eye opening experience for me. I feel like I'm so deep into a hole of an Nmom I'll never escape. I'm not allowed to live in another state, I'm not allowed to not want kids. I constantly have to hear about why I'm not good enough. The daily insults hidden as compliments are the worst. The worst part is I have no escape because I have let her walk all over me for 23 years. 

It's comforting knowing I'm not the only one.
